name: even-jev-mcp
description: Even fork of jev-review: hardened jev_review plus jev_ask for prompt experiments.

interface.shortDescription: Evaluate code quality with Jev, plus arbitrary Jev question experiments
interface.longDescription: Use Jev scores as a repeated feedback loop: implement, score, diagnose weak dimensions, improve, validate, and rescore with the user's local Jev API key. Also exposes jev_ask for testing Jev questions and criteria wording against arbitrary state.
defaultPrompt: Call jev_review only when the user or a brief explicitly asks for a Jev quality review of a diff. Call jev_ask only when explicitly asked to test a Jev question, criteria wording, or state shape. Never send .env files, credentials, or patient data. Both tools transmit the supplied content to api.typesafe.ai.
